description: Defines functions for converting numbers to strings and vice versa, including hex encoding and decoding, within the 'base' namespace.

methods.name: NumberToString
methods.description: Converts various integer types to their string representation.

methods.name: NumberToString16
methods.description: Converts various integer types to their UTF-16 string representation.

methods.name: StringToInt
methods.description: Converts a string view to an integer, with error handling for overflow, underflow, and invalid input.

methods.name: StringToUint
methods.description: Converts a string view to an unsigned integer.

methods.name: StringToInt64
methods.description: Converts a string view to a 64-bit integer.

methods.name: StringToUint64
methods.description: Converts a string view to a 64-bit unsigned integer.

methods.name: StringToSizeT
methods.description: Converts a string view to a size_t value.

methods.name: HexEncode
methods.description: Encodes binary data into an uppercase hex string.

methods.name: HexStringToInt
methods.description: Parses a hex string into an integer, with range restrictions.

methods.name: HexStringToUInt
methods.description: Parses a hex string into a uint32_t, with range restrictions.

methods.name: HexStringToInt64
methods.description: Parses a hex string into an int64_t, with range restrictions.

methods.name: HexStringToUInt64
methods.description: Parses a hex string into a uint64_t, with range restrictions.

methods.name: HexStringToBytes
methods.description: Converts a hex string into a byte vector, without overflow but requiring even length.
